1479-2841-8104-8338.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
1479-2841-8104-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

997-2317-6763-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

2104-2707-5498.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Lantern by paying {3}, causing you to put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1116-4279-5332--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1116-4279-5332--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-736-2459-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Copy Enchantment trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Copy Enchantment.
Repeat.
708-736-2459-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3413-5929-6446.description:
Activate Silvar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Silvar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-7175.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3641-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3641-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
3641-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

589-2275-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-2275-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3765-6102-7735.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-6102-7735.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-6102-7735.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

4872-7012-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Airbender Ascension.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7706.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing White Widow.
When White Widow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When White Widow enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and up to one other creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4613-5446-5508-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
4613-5446-5508-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
When the Cats enter, Railway Brawler triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each Cat.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

2232-6749-7193.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-6749-7193.description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Omni-Changeling enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Omni-Changeling from the battlefield to your hand.
When Omni-Changeling leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Omni-Changeling from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

647-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
647-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

944-2034-4871-5795-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

413-465-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

545-3693-4613.description:
Activate Bloodbond Vampire by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Bloodbond Vampire triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1445-2034-4871-5477.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2034-4871-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2018-3216-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Suncleanser, adding {R}.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Repeat.

575-3967-5624.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2178-2201-2962.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Pirate Ship.
Pirate Ship does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Pirate Ship deathtouch.
Thornbite Staff attached to Pirate Ship.
Pirate Ship does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2201-2962.description:
Activate Pirate Ship by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature dies, Pirate Ship triggers, untapping Pirate Ship.
Repeat.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
Give Pirate Ship deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Pirate Ship by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls, and destroying it due to Pirate Ship's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Pirate Ship triggers, untapping Pirate Ship.
Repeat from step 2.
If the effect giving Pirate Ship deathtouch is a static effect, you may repeat this whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1326-1526-4499-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other creatures.
An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1326-1526-4499-4918.description:
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sage of Shaila's Claim.
Sage of Shaila's Claim enters the battlefield, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Lightning Runner ability from step 1, causing you to get {E}{E}, then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1651-1737-4365.notablePrerequisites: Any artifact with mana value 0 exiled by Prototype Portal.
1651-1737-4365.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating two token copies of the imprinted artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two artifact tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

3086-4050-4681.manaNeeded: {G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3086-4050-4681.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lagrella, adding one mana of any color.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it and Lagrella triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

116-3525-5116.notablePrerequisites:
Kiora's Follower does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kiora's Follower.
116-3525-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
